name: /weekly-review
description: End-of-week review: what shipped, what stalled, interrupt triage

steps.action: Summarize the week and review interrupts
steps.context: Read .exocortex/TODO.md, recent events from .exocortex/events/, .exocortex/control/INTERRUPTS.md, and .exocortex/OPEN_DECISIONS.md. Summarize: what shipped, what stalled. Review interrupts grouped by type. Ask 3 questions: 1) Promote any to next-week focus? 2) Keep parked? 3) Delete? No rewriting history — promote only what earns attention.
Propose specific updates to TODO.md (next-week focus) and SESSION_CONTEXT.md (if direction changed). Show full diff. Ask 'Approve these changes for next week?' Only write after explicit approval.
